decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate exchanger line sits close to the core portfolio and represents sunk certification investment, so management attributes the lack of visible results to pandemic-related market softness and stays committed.
The marine box cooler line is publicly tied to a claimed major market share, which makes it central and highly visible, so dropping it would contradict the firm's own public claims.
The marine cooling unit has a dedicated page and complements the marine cooler offering, so management treats weak marine demand during 2020-2021 as temporary and persists.
The multi-model compact oil cooler line embodies development investment built on established know-how, which management will justify by continuing it rather than writing it off.
Finned tubes are a core component feeding the firm's own air cooler production and are presented on their own page, so they remain strategically central.
The enhanced tubes carry the firm's R&D and efficiency narrative and fit its announced innovation and sustainability direction, so the firm keeps them.
